headline: 🔍 THE FIELDSTONE INSPECTION IS LOCKED — THURSDAY 8/13 AT 11:15, WITH A COMBO CODE ALREADY GIVEN OUT — AND YOUR SELLERS STILL HAVE NOT BEEN TOLD A STRANGER WILL BE IN THEIR HOUSE. ⚡ DO: call the Fieldstone sellers this morning. ⚠️ WATCH: the 198 Rena listing agreement dies Friday 8/14 and the decision is on day five.

notes: 🔑 THE PUBLISH LANE HAS NOW BEEN DOWN FOR SIX DAYS AND IT IS STILL ONE COMMAND. Every board has been rebuilt and committed on schedule; not one of them can ship. The GitHub CLI has been signed out since Monday's migration and the local-only commits keep stacking. What your phone shows is still Tuesday morning. `gh auth login`, once, in Terminal, and the whole queue goes out on the next pass.

✅ YESTERDAY CONVERTED AND THEN CLOSED ITS OWN LOOP. 1709 Fieldstone went under contract at 9:05 AM, the buyer's agent asked for Thursday at 2:35 PM, and you answered by text at 5:30 — inspection set for Thursday 11:15 with the lockbox combo passed to the inspector directly. ⚠️ THE PART THAT IS NOT DONE: nobody has told the sellers. There is no outbound to them in either of your addresses since that text.

🎙️ THREE INSTRUMENTS ARE DARK AND ONE OF THEM IS YOUR EARS. The recorder you wear has captured nothing in eighteen days — that is a device, not an outage. The nightly Deep Dive has not run for three nights, so there is no scorecard since Wednesday. And the Marketing Machine's config files have been missing five days, which is why the graphics and spotlight lanes produce nothing every morning.

callBlock.why: 🔑 CALL HER BEFORE 1:30 TODAY — THERE IS A SHOWING ON THAT LISTING THIS AFTERNOON. She answered interested YES and wrote 'Writing up an offer!' on her form while calling the old number too high, and the number came down without anyone telling her. ⚠️ Two weeks is long enough for that buyer to be under contract elsewhere, so treat this as a re-open, not a live offer. ⛔ Quote $295,000 only.

⭐ THE OTHER 'INTERESTED: YES' ON THE SAME LISTING, and the same story: her only objection was price, and the price has since been answered. ⚠️ Her buyer was cross-shopping another house a week ago — that is either resolved or gone, and one call settles it. ⛔ Quote $295,000 and nothing else.

SHE ASKED FOR A PROFESSIONAL VALUATION IN HER OWN WORDS on 145 Detroit Ave — a seller raising her hand, not a lead to qualify. ✅ Her first-touch email went out yesterday morning by your own hand, so the opener is done and the call is the follow-through, not the introduction.

THE FIRST AND ONLY REPLY THE RECONNECT LANE HAS EVER PRODUCED, now five days old — and he has since become both sides of a deal: he wants something inexpensive on Lay or Logan Martin, you sent him a valuation on his own place, and you are running his mortgage numbers by text. ⭐ A live buyer AND a live seller who raised his own hand, getting colder by the day.

🔴 STILL THE WORST NUMBER ON THIS LIST: ZERO TOUCHES, EVER, and now six days overdue. Third buyer off your 1709 Fieldstone ad, re-engaged himself on a Sunday afternoon, and nothing has gone out to him in any channel. ⭐ That listing is now under contract — which makes him a live buyer with no house attached, not a dead lead.

Fourth name off the 1709 Fieldstone ad in four days, landed 7:47 PM on a Sunday while the instant responder was dark. ⭐ Same point as Anthony M. — the ad that produced her just went under contract, so she is a buyer in your market with nothing left to look at.

Buyer who was live on your site fifteen minutes before her alert fired, on a $415K four-bed in Helena. ⭐ She is also the one confirmed pre-market-list ask on the board — she told you she wanted the ones that are not listed yet, which is a standing reason to call rather than a one-time trigger.

387 Appleford Rd in Helena with roughly $202K in equity, and dark since September 2025. ⭐ An equity-and-silence combination is the classic listing conversation — she is not waiting on you, which is exactly why the call is worth making.

listings.status: 🔍 UNDER CONTRACT $390K → INSPECTION LOCKED Thursday 8/13 at 11:15 AM — and the sellers have not been told
listings.note: 🔑 THE ONE CALL TO MAKE THIS MORNING. The inspector reached you directly by text at 5:08 yesterday evening, you answered by 5:30, and Thursday 11:15 is set — you also gave him the lockbox combo. ⚠️ NOBODY HAS TOLD YOUR SELLERS. A sweep of both your addresses finds no outbound to them since that text, which means a third party has their door code for Thursday and they will learn it from someone other than you unless you call. That is the entire item and it is sixty seconds. ⚠️ THE BUYER'S AGENT ALSO STILL HAS NOTHING IN WRITING. The whole confirmation happened over text with the inspector; the agent who asked 'does Thursday work on your end?' has never had a written yes, and his close-date question from Friday morning is still the last message in its thread. ⭐ ONE THING GOT SETTLED AND ONE DID NOT: your other seller signed the contract Thursday afternoon on two receipts, while the second has open-notices only and no completion — ask him on the call rather than treating it as a red flag, because a single unanswered notice is not evidence of an unsigned document. ⏰ THE CLOSING DATE IS STILL EXECUTED NOWHERE ANY ROUTINE CAN READ — their ask and your position were never reconciled in a document, and the contract PDF has now gone seven days unopened. Thirty seconds with the attachment closes it. 🆕 AND A NEW ONE FOUND THIS MORNING: your CRM has this listing marked EXPIRED while it sits under contract with a Thursday inspection. That is a data problem, not a deal problem, but an expired listing stops feeding every downstream system. ⭐ This one ad is still the best lead source of your week — four names on today's call block came off it.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $295K — A SHOWING TODAY AT 1:30, and both of its interested agents now have names
listings.note: 🔥 TODAY IS THE TEST AND IT STARTS AT 1:30. Two appointments back to back — this afternoon and Monday 1:40 — on a listing where a single booking had been news, and they are the first traffic since the competing offer was confirmed dead. ⭐ BOTH 'INTERESTED: YES' ROWS ON THIS FILE NOW HAVE NAMES, and both were anonymous until Friday. Each objected only to the old price. Neither was ever told it came down. ⏰ MAKE THE CASSIE CALL BEFORE THE 1:30 — if today's buyer likes it, you want the agent who already wrote one offer knowing the number moved, not finding out afterward. ⛔ THE PRICE-QUOTE RULE MATTERS MORE NOW THAT YOU ARE PHONING TWO AGENTS: quote $295,000 and nothing else — across five written reads and one preview, not one agent has ever put a different number on paper. ⚠️ Separately, the price-change post published to Facebook late last night without going through approval. The content is right; the guard is not working, and that is a build item rather than a listing item.

listings.status: ⚠️ Under contract $351K — the appraisal ran Friday morning and 46 hours later no value exists anywhere
listings.note: ⚠️ THE APPRAISAL IS THE STORY, NOT THE REPAIR COUNTER. It ran Friday at 9:00 AM and no value has reported in any lane in about forty-six hours. That is drifting out of comfortable and it is the single number this entire file turns on. ⏰ THE REPAIR ADDENDUM HAS NOW SAT UNANSWERED ON DOTLOOP SINCE FRIDAY 6:35 PM — roughly thirty-seven hours — over a gap of three hundred dollars on a $351,000 contract, with the seller handling HVAC and the other side already saying they will get it signed. Still the cheapest decision on your board, and it is getting more expensive to have left it. ⚠️ Older paper is unsigned too, on a file where the closing agent already holds the earnest money, and the buyers' own home-sale contingency has never been receipted. ⭐ For the seller conversation: contract price is $351,000, not the $369,000 list — every repair dollar comes off a net that already carries $8,000 in closing costs and a warranty.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $450K — DAY FIVE UNRULED, and your listing agreement dies Friday
listings.note: 🔴 THE HARDEST DEADLINE ON YOUR BOARD AND THE ONLY ONE NOBODY IS TOUCHING. Your listing agreement expires Friday 8/14 — five days — while the counter under discussion proposes a contingency deadline more than two weeks past your authority to represent these sellers. ⏰ THE DECISION HAS BEEN OPEN SINCE 8/6 AND EVERY SWEEP HAS FOUND ZERO NEW TRAFFIC — no email, no text, no voicemail on this file since the buyer's agent's second voicemail on 8/5, now four days of silence on both sides. ⚠️ He asked for a counter number out loud, twice, and named his own buyer's ceiling while doing it — a buyer negotiating against himself, which only happens while he thinks somebody is listening. ⚠️ THE SEQUENCE IS THE PROBLEM: you cannot quote a counter your sellers have not approved, so the seller call comes first — and it is the same call that gets the agreement extended. Eighty-three days on market with one offer is the context that call needs.

listings.status: 🎉 The listing appointment HELD Saturday — and they replied warm the same afternoon
listings.note: 🎉 THE WEEKEND'S OTHER REAL WIN, AND IT KEPT MOVING AFTER THE MEETING. You built the packet and forwarded it to both sellers sixteen minutes into the slot. ⭐ THEN THEY CAME BACK: the siding was completed October of 2021. That answers neither open question — no signature, no price — but it banks a dated capital improvement straight into the MLS input, and an unprompted reply hours after a listing appointment is exactly the tone you want. ⭐ THE BOARD ALSO EARNED A FACT IT HAD BEEN MISSING SINCE 7/20: the address and price band are known and a dossier exists for the first time. ⭐ It is a two-sided deal — they list this one and buy the next. ⚠️ Nothing is signed yet, which makes the follow-up the whole ballgame, and Monday is the day for it.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $899K — closing Thursday Aug 20, and the extension IS signed
listings.note: ✅ THE ITEM THIS BOARD CARRIED AS OPEN FOR TWO DAYS IS CLOSED, AND THE BOARD HAD IT WRONG. The other side signed the extension addendum Saturday morning — the earlier reading of 'opened and not signed' came from an open-notice that was followed by a completion 43 seconds later that nobody read. Correction recorded rather than quietly dropped. ✅ THE DEAL IS OTHERWISE CLEAN: inspections done including septic, appraisal complete, and the re-issued closing invite reads Thursday Aug 20 at 3:00 PM at the law firm. ⚠️ ONE ITEM REMAINS AND IT IS YOURS: your brokerage's action-required request for the commission document — that is the paperwork that makes the payout happen, and it is on your call list. ⭐ Same seller as Altamont and Martinwood: three files, one phone call.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $164K — Friday evening's showing is now 37 hours old with no written read
listings.note: ⚠️ STILL THE ONE TO WATCH. A showing ran Friday at 6:00 PM and no read has filed in about thirty-seven hours — the oldest unanswered fresh tour on the board, on the listing holding the only unqualified 'interested YES, priced just right' this board has ever taken. ✅ YOU CLOSED THE AGENT CALL LATE FRIDAY NIGHT, five days after that yes landed. ⚠️ CLOSING THE CALL DID NOT MOVE THE BLOCKER, BECAUSE THE BLOCKER IS A DECISION: authorize a concession and trade a later close for a signed contract, or hold at list and let her buyer wait on a bonus that may or may not arrive. ⚠️ You still have not asked your seller for a number, and a decision with nothing behind it is theatre. ⏰ This file has also read AGREEMENT EXPIRING since 7/22 with no date ever pulled from the notice — eighteen days of an unread clock.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $559K — too high on the first read since the contract died, and five days quiet since
listings.note: ⚠️ THE FIRST TOUR AFTER A RE-LIST IS THE READ A PROPERTY GETS GRADED ON, and this one came back too high with the worst staging score on file. The two reads before the contract both said JUST RIGHT, so the shift is real and recent. 🔴 A HARDER QUESTION IS STILL OPEN: there is no bond on the EIFS here. On synthetic stucco a buyer's inspector finds that independently, and it is a plausible part of why a contract already died once. ⏰ NO NEW TOUR HAS BEEN BOOKED SINCE 8/4 — five days — and this file is down to two written reads in the window. ⭐ THE STAGING SCORE IS FIXABLE TODAY AND COSTS NOTHING. Fix that before anyone touches price.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $189K — the approved cut is seventeen days old, still unverified, and there is no feedback history left
listings.note: 🔴 THE RISK IS TWO PUBLIC PRICES, NOT A SLOW SALE. A cut was approved just over two weeks ago with no receipt anywhere that it took effect in the MLS — on a listing that has now gone twenty-eight days without a showing. ✅ Two minutes to pull the MLS line and close it. ⚠️ THIS FILE NOW HAS NO FEEDBACK HISTORY AT ALL — the single written read that ever said the price was too high has fallen outside the fourteen-day window. ⭐ Same seller as Altamont and Lake Crest — three files, one phone call.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $364K — a read validated your price eleven days ago and the seller still has not been told
listings.note: 🔴 DAY ELEVEN OF A SELLER NOT HEARING GOOD NEWS, and the deadline is now inside a week: that read ages out of the fourteen-day window on Friday, at which point the only positive datapoint this listing has ever produced disappears off the board. A price called JUST RIGHT by someone with no reason to flatter it, overall rating 4 of 5, is exactly what an out-of-state condo seller wants to hear. ⚠️ A validated price with no buyer is a marketing conversation — and you cannot have it with someone who does not know the price was validated.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $1.15M — one tour in fourteen days, no written read, and the open house is nine days back
listings.note: ⚠️ YOUR MOST EXPENSIVE LISTING, SELLERS LIVING IN IT, exactly one booked tour in fourteen days and no written feedback at all. ⏰ Sunday's open house is nine days back and exists only in your head — well past the point where detail survives. Five minutes of dictation makes it usable; another week and it is gone. ✅ The marketing block on this listing cleared — the photo problem was a false alarm, all ten photos are live, and the carousel shipped. ⭐ THE LAND COMPONENT IS PINNED: the parcel runs 40 acres, and the one written objection this file has ever taken was about the land, not the price.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — she read your pre-list plan Thursday and the tenant answer is now seventeen days owed
listings.note: ⭐ SHE WAS BACK ON THE SITE 38 MINUTES AFTER YOUR PRE-LIST EMAIL — that is a seller reading her own plan and thinking about it, and it is the warmest this file has been in two weeks. 🔴 A CLIENT WHO HAS TO CHASE TWICE ON SOMETHING ORDINARY STARTS ASSUMING THE HARDER QUESTIONS WILL GO THE SAME WAY. Sixty seconds, whether or not you have the answer. ✅ The ceiling-height video she asked for has gone out, so the reason to call is concrete rather than apologetic. ⚠️ The condo scope email you promised 'shortly' is still owed.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active — cut $325K→$320K on 8/6 and the market has never been told
listings.note: ⚠️ A PRICE CUT NOBODY CAN SEE IS NOT A PRICE CUT. The reduction was made Wednesday and the announcement has sat unpublished ever since — three days of a listing carrying a stale public number while the seller believes it has been repriced. ⭐ Same failure shape as 821 Martinwood, and both are minutes to close. ⚠️ It was caught again in the marketing queue yesterday and re-contained, which means the guard is holding here even as it failed on Comanche.

listings.status: 🔴 Buyer-side $2.35M — the largest number on your board, and your written position still has not gone across
listings.note: 🔴 FIVE ASKS AND OVER TWO WEEKS OF SILENCE. Your own message told the other side you would entertain a reverse offer — a real position stated verbally with nothing on paper behind it. ⭐ The written feedback they have asked for five times IS your negotiating position; writing it is not a favour to them, it is putting your number on the record.

listings.status: 🔥 Cash deal — contract finalized and earnest money delivered; due diligence is the clock now
listings.note: 🔥 STILL THE FASTEST THING ON THIS BOARD BY A WIDE MARGIN — an offer-to-counter-to-counter round trip inside one day, and you confirmed the contract is finalized and earnest money delivered. ✅ THE ACREAGE BLOCKER IS RETIRED: the seller's own two numbers imply roughly 157.6 acres — the first acreage ever stated on this tract — so the deal can be valued. ⏰ THE DUE-DILIGENCE PACKAGE IS STAGED AND UNSTARTED, waiting on your word: a dated checklist with one line per item, because a DD period is a clock and a single task cannot show what is about to expire. ⚠️ A small conflict between two acreage figures remains on file; it changes the math at the margins, not the deal.

listings.client: ⚠️ seller verified, property still unnamed on the paperwork
listings.status: 🆕 A signed listing agreement that no system in the fleet can see — day seven
listings.note: 🆕 The signature is real and receipted; the parcel is not named anywhere in the document. ⚠️ Until it has an address it cannot be marketed, cannot be counted, and cannot be watched by any routine — it is inventory that exists only as a promise, and it is aging.

listings.addr: 19 Lots Deer Ridge Lakes · 2082 Narrows Point Cv · 118 Hayesbury Ln
listings.status: 🆕 COMING SOON — and two of them were supposed to go live THIS WEEKEND per your own note
listings.note: 🆕 YOU TOLD THE SYSTEM FRIDAY NIGHT THAT THE NARROWS LOT AND THE NINETEEN DEER RIDGE LOTS GO ON THE MARKET THIS WEEKEND — won inventory that nothing on this board was tracking as imminent, and the weekend is now here with no go-live receipt yet. ✅ They are recorded as COMING SOON rather than ACTIVE because the engine never demotes a status, so stamping them ACTIVE early would have been permanent. ⭐ They are visible to every routine instead of invisible, which is the point.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED AND PAID — and the feedback you owe the other agent is now openly overdue
listings.note: 🎉 ✅ PAID — ahead of what was modelled, which retires it from the stranded column entirely. ⚠️ WHAT DOES NOT RETIRE: the listing side asked for feedback three times and never got it, and their last ask is now eight days old. ⭐ The closing changed what that silence means — before it read as an oversight, now it reads as a shrug at the agent across the table on a deal you both just completed and both just got paid on. Their listing has since gone EXPIRED, so the window where your feedback is still useful to them is closing.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED 7/30 — day ten, and the money still has not reached the bank
listings.note: ⚠️ A closing with no receipted commission ten days later is the shape of a problem, not a delay — especially in a week where the business account has been the constraint every single day. ⭐ 683 Flag just proved these do land: that one was carried in this same column and paid Thursday, ahead of model.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED + FUNDED — one clean, one with a stranded payout
listings.note: ⚠️ WHISPERING PINES IS STILL STRANDED on an open agent-of-record question. ✅ THE HALF THAT WAS BLOCKING IT HAS MOVED: the teammate licence-compliance item was answered Thursday and both halves are done, so the administrative obstacle behind that question is cleared. Chase the payout itself now.

listings.note: ✅ Real money already on the board that had been missing from the count.

listings.status: 🛡️ Buyer-side — suppressed from the milestone engine, correctly
listings.note: ✅ The roster labelled you listing agent; four receipts say the other side holds the sellers. The guard went in before a wrong milestone could fire a seller email at someone who is not your seller.

listings.addr: 3035 County Line Rd · 104 95th St N · 361 White Oak Cir · 1230 Calvert Rd · 42770 Hwy 77
listings.status: Active — quiet and confirmed yours, carried deliberately rather than dropped
listings.note: ✅ THEY APPEAR HERE ON PURPOSE RATHER THAN BEING DROPPED — a listing that vanishes because nothing happened is how a seller goes ninety days without a call. ⚠️ 361 White Oak is the one real media blocker in the current marketing queue and has been flagged again this morning; the other four are covered.

pipeline.note: ⚠️ THESE NUMBERS ARE SIX DAYS OLD AND SAID SO OUT LOUD. They come from the Weekly Pipeline & Forecast of Monday 8/3 — Gene 21, account-wide 35 — and no fresher forecast has been issued since, so they are carried rather than re-derived. The next one lands tomorrow morning. ⚠️ A COMPETING FIGURE OF 26 IS CIRCULATING IN THE ADVISOR LEDGER AND IT IS NOT AUTHORITATIVE — the forecast email is the system of record and it says 21. Recorded so no run re-litigates it in the other direction. 21 at day 221 is about 6 behind an on-pace 27 and annualises to 36. ⏰ THE REAL DEADLINE IS NOT DECEMBER 31 — at 60–75 days contract-to-close, anything counting for 2026 has to be under contract by roughly October 31, now under twelve weeks. 🎉 FIELDSTONE IS THE MOVEMENT: under contract Saturday morning, inspection Thursday, and it closes inside 2026 on either date under discussion. First new contract in a week, from a listing that is also still your best lead source. ⭐ The standing target is unchanged and it is the whole game: book 3–4 real appointments this week.

money.note: ⚠️ THE SWEEP FIRED THIS MORNING WITH TWO TRIGGERS AND AN ALERT WENT TO YOUR INBOX. THE SHAPE OF IT, WITHOUT NUMBERS: the fortnight's scheduled bills materially exceed the bank-stamped balance, so the account is projected short before those bills clear, and one vendor invoice came due yesterday. That is a forecast plus a due date, not a bounce. ✅ NOTHING HAS ACTUALLY FAILED — a direct sweep of the last 24 hours finds no returned item, no insufficient-funds notice and no low-balance warning. Fifth clean day on the only signal that is directly observable. ✅ THE WEEKEND WAS QUIET IN THE RIGHT WAY: zero business-account movement, and the investment side ticked up slightly. 🔴 THE ONE GENUINELY SERIOUS THING IS UNCHANGED AND IS NOW FIVE DAYS OLD: the accounting system's cash figure is overstated by a very large multiple because its bank connection expired and was never re-linked. Every routine that has read the books for cash has been reading a number far too high. Only the bank-stamped figure is usable until that link is restored. 🆕 A SECOND BOOKS FILE WENT MISSING TODAY — the benchmark set the Monday budget review runs on is not on this machine, so tomorrow's budget-versus-benchmark and subscription audit cannot compute until it is restored. ⭐ THE MONTH ITSELF IS NOT THE PROBLEM: August models above the survive line. September is the hole — and Fieldstone going under contract is the first real movement toward filling it.

isa.decayPolicy: ⚠️ 58 OPEN, UP FROM 54 LAST NIGHT, WITH 14 AT p1 — AND EVERY p1 IS OVERDUE OR DUE TODAY. ⭐ THE LIST IS NOT ROTTING, IT IS UNATTENDED, and most of the growth is the machine working rather than the backlog decaying: eight of the rows are staged drafts waiting on your send-or-kill, and a large block of the rest are contactless address-only seller records queued for re-check — records that arrived with no name, no phone and no email, correctly held at zero touch rather than guessed at. 🔥 THE p1 BLOCK IS WHERE THE MONEY IS: four named buyers off a single listing ad, a past client who replied to a reconnect email in 82 minutes, a Panama City seller who asked for a valuation in her own words, two land questions, and two named buyer's agents on the same listing whose only objection has already been answered by a price cut neither was told about. 🔴 THE NUMBER THAT SHOULD BOTHER YOU IS NOT 58 — IT IS THAT THE OLDEST p1 HAS ZERO TOUCHES OF ANY KIND, SIX DAYS IN, and he came off the exact ad that went under contract Saturday. ⚠️ THE CONTACTLESS PILE IS NOW A DECISION, NOT A QUEUE: eighteen address-only seller records have been re-pulled repeatedly and enrichment has returned a name, phone or email on exactly none of them. The +24h re-check habit is 0-for-18 and it is time to either find another way to identify these owners or stop re-queuing them. That question is written up and waiting on you. ⚠️ Six inbound leads still cannot be texted at all — they typed a number into your own form that carries a do-not-call marker, and no rule exists yet for what to do with them. ⚠️ Four of Friday's ten database rows have no phone number, because the file that joins a name to a phone never made it off the old machine.
isa.sweepCadence: ✅ CADENCE HELD ALL WEEKEND AND SUNDAY IS RUNNING CORRECTLY QUIET — the sweep has been firing on a clean half-hourly incremental since 6 AM and returning true zeros on every instrument, which is what a Sunday should look like. Under your own no-touch rule nothing goes out today; the queue is being built for Monday 7 AM, not worked now. 🛑 THE SEND GATES ARE DOING EXACTLY WHAT YOU WROTE: cold and never-contacted leads auto-send, everyone else drafts, clients and agents get no email at all. ⚖️ AN ALARM FROM FRIDAY MORNING WAS INVESTIGATED AND REFUTED RATHER THAN BELIEVED, and the correction is worth knowing: the sweep declared a hard send-rule breach — four sequence emails apparently sent without permission — and demoted its own send lane on the spot. A controlled test proved the mechanism it blamed does not send. The real cause was you clearing your own drafts folder. No breach happened, and the demotion was unwound in-run. ⚖️ TWO QUESTIONS REPEAT EVERY RUN UNTIL YOU RULE THEM, and both are now three days old: your physical business address for cold-email footers — which has already cost one hot never-contacted Panama City seller a sent email — and whether the fleet may DRAFT a note to a co-op agent when you explicitly ask for one, which you have now asked six times and been answered with a call script six times.
